notes.title: Gloomy Eyes is coming to PC and consoles — A Word from the Gravekeeper 🌕🌕
notes.content:
Even though the sun left, there’s still light in the darkness…



Hello, Wanderer.

It’s not every day the dead have news worth sharing.

But today… oh, today is quite the exception.



Through shadows and soil, with the help of Untold Tales

Gloomy Eyes will rise to PC and consoles.




It’s a tale I’ve long watched from my perch beneath the stones. 

A boy with no heartbeat.

A girl who walks toward the dark.

And a sun that forgot how to shine.




The living will see what lies beneath.

And the world will finally hear our side of the tale.




Here's a first glimpse of what's to come. Watch closely.

Exclusively revealed by IGN:


[previewyoutube="in2LBOovYXc;full"][/previewyoutube]


And remember… 

A single firefly’s glow can spark a thousand dreams.

Be that spark – add Gloomy Eyes to your wishlist.





[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2667950/Gloomy_Eyes/"][/dynamiclink]



~ The Gravekeeper

Speaker for the silent.
